report: AgentHost Phase C - Agent Zero Installation Record
installation_method: Docker container (official image), manual docker CLI (preferred in playbook order: Docker first)
base_image: Not exposed (official image); container Python 3.13.14 system + /opt/venv-a0 virtualenv (Python 3.12) for the app
volume: a0_eval_usr -> /a0/usr (user data: settings, agents, projects, memory, skills, plugins, uploads, workdir)
environment_variables_note: A0_SET_* mechanism is LEGACY in v2.8; model config is now file-based (plugin _model_config): /a0/usr/plugins/_model_config/{presets.yaml,config.json}
runtime_config_changes: Wrote preset 'Local Ollama' in /usr/plugins/_model_config/presets.yaml (ollama qwen2.5-coder:14b chat+utility, api_base http://host.docker.internal:11434, local huggingface embeddings)

api_credentials.auth_model: X-API-KEY header; token = base64url(sha256(runtime_id:auth_login:auth_password))[:16], changed when credentials change
api_credentials.eval_token: generated at runtime with default (empty) credentials; NOTE: with empty UI credentials the token is stable and derived from public inputs - credentials should be set before any non-loopback exposure

startup_command: docker run -d --name a0-eval -p 5080:80 -v a0_eval_usr:/a0/usr -e A0_SET_... agent0ai/agent-zero:latest
startup_time_observed: HTTP 200 on Web UI ~20s after container start
health_check: GET http://localhost:5080 -> 200 when up; container logs show 'Agent Zero is running.' + 'Uvicorn running on http://0.0.0.0:80'; no dedicated /health endpoint observed
restart_behavior: docker restart a0-eval: Web UI back to HTTP 200 within ~20-25s; volume data (presets, .env keys, workdir) persists
host_side_effects: Docker Desktop (installed, previously stopped) was started; its WSL distros auto-started many pre-existing third-party containers on the host (user-authorized side effect)
Created named Docker volume a0_eval_usr (~ a few GB of user data)
windows_notes: Docker Desktop + WSL2 backend required; works out of the box on Windows 11 Home
Model server on host reachable via http://host.docker.internal:11434 (verified usable for Ollama)
Full Linux desktop + LibreOffice are part of the image; Browser/Desktop surfaces are available in the Web UI
Non-Docker Windows 'native' path exists (dev-setup) but RFC (Remote Function Calls) is required there for shell; Docker path used and recommended

model_configuration_requirements.chat_llm: Required. v2.8 unified_turn protocol requires strict tool-call JSON output; verified local 14B-class models fail the protocol on multi-tool flows (5x unusable-response guard), strong cloud models recommended by project
model_configuration_requirements.utility_llm: Required; used for memory extraction/summarization each turn; project docs warn small models (<=4B) unreliable
model_configuration_requirements.embedding_llm: Optional; default local huggingface sentence-transformers on CPU; observed auto-pull of bge-m3 (embedding) into host Ollama when huggingface provider unavailable in some config states
